prompt: Inside a timber dock warehouse at night, 28mm, straight-on at chest height and close: three clean-shaven men of about 60 to 75 in three-piece suits and fedoras tipped back stand shoulder to shoulder, faces large and bare, mouths open wide mid-shout, drum-fed submachine guns held out at arm's length and pointing up at the rafters. Behind them a fourth man with his back to us has a fireman's axe sunk into a barrel in a long stack, whiskey pouring from the split staves. Ankle-deep spilled whiskey covers the floor like a mirror. A string of coral-pink bulbs lights their mouths and doubles in the flood; cobalt moonlight slants through the loading doors onto the rain-wet dock. Thanks.
